cleanup_policy: Same as the 14-case redocking benchmark: chain A only, standard amino acids only (waters/SO4/glycerol/glycans removed), PDB2PQR 3.7.1 AMBER/propka at the state-specific pH, --pdb-output.

missing_atom_warnings: GLN A 497: missing OXT (C-terminal carboxylate oxygen, routine/expected)

pocket_proximity_qc.method: distance from GLN497 CA (the only missing-atom-warning residue) to the docking box center
pocket_proximity_qc.note: GLN497 is the protein's C-terminal residue; its only missing atom is OXT, a routine unresolved terminal carboxylate oxygen, not a pocket-lining side chain.

box_derivation.method: 3GXF_prepared.pdb chain D (the chain the case's IFM ligand is actually bound to, per gcase_validation_set_v1.0.json auth_chain) C-alpha atoms superposed onto each new receptor's chain A C-alpha atoms (Bio.PDB.Superimposer, Kabsch algorithm, all 497 common residues); reference_ligands/3GXF_IFM.sdf heavy-atom coordinates transformed with the same rotation/translation; box = transformed heavy-atom extent + 6 A padding per axis (same padding convention as the 14-case GNINA boxes).
box_derivation.sanity_check: Box center lies 8.4-8.8 A from both catalytic-residue C-alpha atoms (E235, E340) in both states -- consistent with a pocket-centered box (a mis-mapped chain/residue-numbering error would put this at 20+ A).
